gaps.explanation: p9 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints enterprise columns Electric, Water, Sewer, Trash with no schedule of their own; detail[] has no business-type lines. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 518,727 + interest income 5,543 + franchise fees 98,564 = 622,834. Per column: Electric 1,887 + 5,237 = 7,124; Water 271,477 + 246 + 306 + 49,282 = 321,311; Sewer 150,366 + 261 + 49,282 = 199,909; Trash 94,490. Sum 622,834 = statement.
